title: NFLComp — Autonomous NFL Betting Strategy Research & Competition
description: Autonomous NFL betting-strategy research, backtesting, forward-testing and paper-trading competition platform, explicitly a paper-trading research prototype rather than a production betting system. State read from the repository's own data/summary.json at commit 7ec80df: 70 strategy personas across 17 categories, 23 of them carrying a version lineage and every one flat-staking a $10,000 paper bankroll; 7,548 tracked games of which 7,308 are completed and 240 upcoming, spanning 1999 to 2026 with the current week at 3 of the 2026 season; a simulated ledger of 97,218 wagers carrying a total competition simulated PnL of -$531,192.71 (a net loss across all personas), 646 upcoming bets and 326 open positions; and 16,343 Kalshi trade prints of which 1,463 are published on the site. The published ledger window is 2020-2026, holding 31,502 bets at -$221,808.53, against the all-time 97,218 bets at -$531,192.71. The top performer is now @AnalyticsCoach_ATS_v1 at +$3,839.32 and a +4.16% ROI; @AltSpread_Value_v2, which this directory's previous entry named as the top persona at +27.15% ROI and +$145,992.37, now shows 0 bets and is listed as n/a (open) in the forward-test column, so that claim is superseded rather than carried. Strategy development is the declared main loop and is quoted from the README: declare the hypothesis, required source fields, market, side and threshold in code before reading the holdout result; develop on 2000-2019, validate on 2020-2022 and evaluate once on a 2023-2025 holdout without threshold tuning; keep failures archived unchanged; and promote only to prospective paper testing when the gate passes — at least 100 development, 40 validation and 40 holdout bets with positive ROI in all three windows — because, as the README puts it, a positive holdout is not a profit guarantee. The 33-control audit was executed here and all 33 pass.

Three commits landed during this audit adding an explicit evidence policy: docs/DATA_TRUTH.md defines SOURCE_DATA, DERIVED_DATA, MODEL_OUTPUT, FORWARD_TEST and UNVERIFIED classes and four settlement gates, states that the loader preserves a missing side price as null and never supplies a conventional -110, and records that historical player props are flagged and excluded rather than settled from a model probability. docs/OPERATIONAL_STATUS.md lists what is actually executable today.
